conflicts.details: Current-game source lists The Cell Games Begin as PQ 36, while an older project rule described PQ 36 as a numbering gap. The canonical player-facing layer retains PQ36; the older interpretation remains provenance and does not change the 186-record canonical count.

Several guides list rewards but do not consistently identify whether each reward is a normal-clear, Ultimate-Finish, or opponent-specific drop. The batch therefore keeps all records partially verified.
